title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.34811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. translated_title: HOG-WAM：通过未来梯度预测提升视觉鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型（world-action models）联合预测未来观测与动作，然而视觉损坏可能会干扰由此产生的策略。我们提出HOG-WAM，它将未来的方向梯度直方图（HOG）作为结构监督信号，直接从演示图像中获取。一个辅助的HOG扩散Transformer（DiT）模块通过非对称注意力读取RGB特征，使其训练目标能够塑造用于控制的视觉表征。该模块仅在训练期间使用，在推理时被移除，从而保留了FastWAM的RGB到动作架构。我们通过RoboTwin的视觉损坏扩展版本（称为RoboTwin-Plus）评估了四种受控的观测损坏；在全部四种损坏下，HOG-WAM在所比较的策略中取得了最高的成功率。相对于FastWAM，混合噪声下的成功率从78.86%提升至82.86%，同时在干净场景上保持相当的性能。在LIBERO Plus上，总体成功率也从74.49%进一步提升。
tldr: HOG-WAM通过引入仅在训练阶段使用的辅助HOG扩散Transformer模块来预测演示图像的未来梯度结构，为世界-动作模型提供结构性视觉监督，从而在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升策略在视觉损坏下的鲁棒性与成功率。
en_tdlr: HOG-WAM enhances the visual robustness of world-action models by training an auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer that provides structural supervision on future demonstration gradients, which is removed at inference, achieving higher success rates under visual corruptions.
